rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday way to ask or discuss whether an object, document, or claim is genuine rather than fake.

example.english: I'm not sure about the authenticity of this antique certificate.
example.traditional: 我唔肯定呢份古董證書真定假。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 hang2 ding6 ne1 fan6 gu2 dung2 zing3 syu1 zan1 ding6 gaa2

rows.note: Use this more formal noun when discussing the abstract quality of something being genuine, especially in certification or official writing.

example.english: The report needs to verify the authenticity of these artefacts.
example.traditional: 報告需要驗證呢批文物嘅真實性。
example.jyutping: bou3 gou3 seoi1 jiu3 jim6 zing3 ne1 pai1 man4 mat6 ge3 zan1 sat6 sing3
